descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S16 Another device of the same physician, including one with a wrong clock and time zone, shows the same attendance, live

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock. (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Browser A (normal clock) on Today's Visits with the fixture resident on it. Browser B: a second context of the same physician with page.clock fixed at server day D+2 and timezoneId 'Pacific/Kiritimati'

When B un-marks the resident, then marks it again; A is not reloaded. Then A and B each show Today's Visits, All Residents and the Nursing Home dashboard

Then A drops the resident, then shows them again, without a reload. A and B list the same residents with the same toggle states, and their dashboard numbers match (UAT 3.8: a wrong clock or time zone shows the same state)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s16-after-unmark has no {snfResident}; s16-after-mark has it (T1 across devices). B's checkpoints hold the same absolute expectations as A's final state: Today's Visits has the resident and no 'In Today ✓', All Residents has the resident and 'In Today ✓', and both dashboards show counts Total 1 / Pending 1 (3.8)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
